Screen capture is not supported on this Android version. Requires Android 13+.
Could not select Translate in Google Lens.
Turn Screen Translator off and on in Accessibility settings to enable automatic translation.

1. Add the app to Smart Sidebar (Settings → Smart Sidebar → customize).\n2. Pin/lock the app in recents so ColorOS keeps it running.\n3. Enable the capture service once. A sidebar tap then captures the screen, opens Google Lens, and selects Translate automatically.
Captures your screen and opens it in Google Lens. After each capture, inspects Lens controls for up to 10 seconds and selects Translate at most once.
